faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find yours? Ask in the chat itself

items.a: Tap "Try {days} days free" and say hi on WhatsApp. It works on your phone or your computer.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: You get {days} days with everything in Premium, counted from your first message. No card needed. Premium Pro has no trial: it has a 7 day guarantee.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: The diary stops logging until you subscribe. Everything you logged stays saved and comes back in full when you subscribe.

items.q: How do I pay and cancel?
items.a: Right in the chat: reply "subscribe", choose monthly or yearly and pay by Pix or card. Cancel whenever you like; your access lasts until the end of the period you paid for. Premium Pro is a program you pay for once, upfront by Pix or in installments by card, with no renewal.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: Within 7 days of paying, for Premium or Premium Pro, ask for a refund in the chat and it goes through on its own, as the Brazilian Consumer Protection Code provides.

items.q: Who looks after my plan on Premium Pro?
items.a: You do a full assessment and get a diet and training built for you, under the responsibility of a registered dietitian (CRN) and a certified trainer (CREF). They follow you through the check-ins and the monthly reassessment and answer your questions in the chat within 24 hours.
No. The chat assistant logs, adds up and informs; it doesn't prescribe diets or workouts. On Premium Pro, your diet and training are under the responsibility of licensed professionals.
It's used only for your diary. Say "delete my data" and everything is deleted, as Brazil's data protection law (LGPD) provides.
